translations.web: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
translations.bsb: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
translations.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
translations.asv: What doth it profit, my brethren, if a man say he hath faith, but have not works? can that faith save him?
